purpose: Freeze the validated M0-G analytical geometry as a reference-only handoff for downstream section completion and EdiLus/open-source FEM model construction without duplicating canonical ledgers or repairing unresolved evidence by inference.

coordinate_frame.xy_frame: PT_MASTER_CURRENT common frame propagated through STOREY_SUPPORT_XY_REGISTRATION_v1.csv
coordinate_frame.rule: Relative structural Z may be used exactly as registered; absolute/project/geodetic Z must not be invented.

g5_confirmed_oblique_beam.counting_rule: Count exactly once among the 36 G5 ordinary beams; the linked roof-special feature is not a second member.

mandatory_downstream_watches.rule: Do not copy or infer sections from adjacent beams/storeys.

mandatory_downstream_watches.scope: Vertical column segments affected by G3 support-section watches 18 and 21
mandatory_downstream_watches.rule: Preserve endpoint evidence independently; do not promote MIS to DOC.
TAV-06S local 2.10/3.75 m and TAV-06E 2.20 m upper-module evidence are not a proven common global-Z binding.
Do not invent a unique analytical/structural centerline from documentary edge-set geometry.
Registered metric XY may be used with MIS provenance only; no MIS-to-DOC promotion.
Do not derive absolute/project/geodetic elevation from the relative structural datum.

downstream_authorized_use: Construct the analytical superstructure geometry using the referenced node, rigid-link and member-connectivity ledgers.
Use the relative G1-G5 level system as currently registered.
Carry source evidence and WATCH/ND states into section completion and model-input preparation.
Use G5-B036 once as the confirmed 19-26 oblique ordinary beam.
Keep the six roof-special geometries outside ordinary frame connectivity unless later primary-source evidence authorizes a member role.
not_authorized_by_this_handoff: Inventing or completing missing beam/column sections.
Assigning materials, mechanical properties, reinforcement, loads, masses, diaphragms, releases, boundary conditions or soil parameters without separate canonical evidence.
Converting ridge/eave geometry into structural members without explicit evidence.
Extending terrace supports a-d above G1 or roof-absent supports above G4.
Treating foundation geometry/details as completed unless separately handed off by the foundation workflow.
completion_statement: M0-G geometry is frozen and suitable as the canonical geometric/topological basis for downstream model construction. PASS_WITH_WATCH does not close the listed evidence gaps and does not authorize silent completion of any ND/MIS field.
